title: Trajectory analysis of sleep disorders and anxiety-depression in female breast cancer patients undergoing chemotherapy: based on group-based Multi-Trajectory Model and machine learning.
summary: primary Methods/Results document the AI-enabled result, evaluation and bounded interpretation. Publication venue was not available in the checked primary metadata. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: LASSO selected predictors for seven compared machine-learning models that classified symptom-trajectory groups in a prospective chemotherapy cohort; the group-based multi-trajectory model itself was statistical.
organization: Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine

evidence.tested: In 150 breast-cancer patients followed through four chemotherapy cycles, the group-based multi-trajectory model identified stable (74.7%) and deteriorating (25.3%) sleep/anxiety-depression symptom groups. Seven machine-learning models assessed factors associated with the deteriorating group; the selected Naive Bayes model had test AUC 0.863, accuracy 0.839 and Brier score 0.132. Risk-factor associations are not causal.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and prospective real-world benefit are not established in the reviewed study.
evidence.ai_role: LASSO selected predictors for seven compared machine-learning models that classified symptom-trajectory groups in a prospective chemotherapy cohort; the group-based multi-trajectory model itself was statistical.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
